name: 01. Apify Scraper & Supabase Ingestion (Auto-Rotating Country Queue)

parameters.query:
SELECT 
    id AS queue_id,
    country,
    city_or_region,
    target_location
FROM public.v_n8n_active_scraping_queue
LIMIT 1;

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "enrichLeads": true,
  "extractEmail": true,
  "location": "{{ $json.target_location }}",
  "maxResults": 50,
  "onlyWithPhone": true,
  "onlyWithWebsite": true,
  "proxyConfiguration": {
    "useApifyProxy": true,
    "apifyProxyGroups": []
  },
  "searchTerms": [
    "Indonesian restaurant",
    "Indonesian food",
    "Indonesian cuisine",
    "Indonesian restaurant {{ $json.target_location }}",
    "Nusantara restaurant",
    "Nusantara cuisine",
    "Indonesian cafe",
    "Indonesian halal restaurant",
    "Indonesian catering",
    "Padang restaurant",
    "Nasi Padang",
    "Warung Indonesia"
  ]
}

parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO b2b_leads (
    place_id, name, clean_name, category, country, city, address,
    latitude, longitude, maps_url, phone, email, email_source,
    website, cms, has_contact_form, instagram_url, facebook_url,
    tiktok_url, linkedin_url, rating, review_count, contactability_score,
    lead_priority, status_email, email_sent_count, scraped_at
) VALUES (
    '{{ $json.place_id }}',
    '{{ $json.name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ $json.clean_name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ $json.category.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ $json.country }}',
    '{{ $json.city }}',
    '{{ $json.address.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    {{ $json.latitude !== null ? $json.latitude : 'NULL' }},
    {{ $json.longitude !== null ? $json.longitude : 'NULL' }},
    {{ $json.maps_url ? "'" + $json.maps_url.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    {{ $json.phone ? "'" + $json.phone.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    {{ $json.email ? "'" + $json.email.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    {{ $json.email_source ? "'" + $json.email_source.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    {{ $json.website ? "'" + $json.website.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    {{ $json.cms ? "'" + $json.cms.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    {{ $json.has_contact_form }},
    {{ $json.instagram_url ? "'" + $json.instagram_url.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    {{ $json.facebook_url ? "'" + $json.facebook_url.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    {{ $json.tiktok_url ? "'" + $json.tiktok_url.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    {{ $json.linkedin_url ? "'" + $json.linkedin_url.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    {{ $json.rating }},
    {{ $json.review_count }},
    {{ $json.contactability_score }},
    '{{ $json.lead_priority }}',
    'pending',
    0,
    NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (place_id) DO UPDATE SET
    email = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.email, b2b_leads.email),
    phone = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.phone, b2b_leads.phone),
    website = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.website, b2b_leads.website),
    rating = EXCLUDED.rating,
    review_count = EXCLUDED.review_count,
    contactability_score = EXCLUDED.contactability_score,
    lead_priority = EXCLUDED.lead_priority,
    updated_at = NOW();

=UPDATE b2b_scraping_queue
SET 
    status = 'completed',
    total_leads_collected = total_leads_collected + 1,
    last_scraped_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $('4. Normalize & Standardize Leads').first().json.queue_id }}';
